items.text: Jalen Hurts (calf blood clot) went on IR Oct. 17 and can return no earlier than Week 11; Tanner McKee starts. The schedule data lists Hurts, so the model uses McKee.

Philadelphia (final report): OUT: WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring), WR Dontayvion Wicks (ankle), WR Britain Covey (knee), LB Jihaad Campbell (hamstring/quad), CB Jonathan Jones (hamstring). QUESTIONABLE: CB Jakorian Bennett. RB Saquon Barkley is off the report and plays.

Washington: DT Daron Payne broke his left foot in Friday practice and is out for the season. DT Javon Kinlaw (knee) is OUT. QUESTIONABLE: WR Treylon Burks, TE John Bates, DT Jer'Zhan Newton; C Nick Allegretti (back) is a game-time decision. Stefon Diggs is cleared; Terry McLaurin is on season-ending IR.

adjust.reason: Philadelphia is without WRs DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks, LB Jihaad Campbell and CB Jonathan Jones, which outweighs Washington's loss of DTs Daron Payne and Javon Kinlaw. The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
